HeroSection: Incorporate a 'Control Room' / Tactical feel. Remove the faint circular svg and replace it with a full-bleed cinematic background image (from image_urls.hero_fallback) with a heavy bg-[#F6EFE3]/90 overlay to maintain the cream theme but add aggressive grit.
Change CTA button to recipes.buttons.primary to introduce the solid offset brutalist shadow.
Enhance eyebrow: Add an animated 'Tracing Beam' or tactical line under the eyebrow text.
Make the 'Pro Scout Intelligence' text pop with #2A6B3F.
PricingTiers: Apply Archetype 2 Tactical Minimalism: Remove soft drop shadows. Replace them with solid brutalist borders (border-2) and offset shadows (`shadow-[8px_8px_0_0_#0A1A12]`).
Retain 3-col on mobile, but use gap-1 sm:gap-4.
Add a subtle grain/noise texture overlay to the Premium and VIP cards to make them feel less flat.
Ensure all inner dividers inside pricing cards are sharp (h-[2px] bg-ink or bg-white/20).
FAQSection: Change accordion toggle from soft rotation to a sharp snap animation.
Add a 4px left border (border-l-4 border-[#1F4F2F]) to the open state instead of full box shadow.
Update font sizes to match recipes.typography.h3_card for the questions to give them weight.

WelcomeHeader: Increase padding top to pt-32 pb-24 for breathing room.
Place the 'New upload' button inline with the title using flex-wrap, styling it with recipes.buttons.primary.
UpgradeBanner: Use dark tactical cards for both mini-cards. Premium = #0F3A22, VIP = #0A0F0D.
Add 1px neon inner borders (border-[#A5DD5F]/50 and border-[#F5C443]/50).
Remove soft shadows, add sharp inner glows (shadow-[inset_0_0_20px_rgba(204,255,0,0.05)]).
ReportsLibrary: Change the grid to dense 'Control Room' style: gap-0 border-y border-x border-[#0A1A12]/10. Items share borders (border-r border-b).
Make the preview/premium badges razor-sharp with no rounded corners. bg-[#1F4F2F] text-white or bg-[#0A1A12] text-[#CCFF00].
Ensure image thumbnails have a grayscale filter by default, revealing full color on group-hover (group-hover:grayscale-0 transition-all duration-500) to feel like scout analysis footage.
PlayersList: Convert rows into technical 'register' lines. Use 1px border-b border-[#0A1A12]/10.
Hover state: from bg-[#FFFAF1] to bg-[#CCFF00]/10 transition.
Align Premium/Upgrade badges strictly to the right edge with monospaced positioning.

image_generation_prompts_nano_banana.LandingHeroBackground: Cinematic wide-angle photography of a pristine football pitch at night. Heavy mist, blinding stadium floodlights cutting through the dark. Monochromatic forest green and deep black tones. High contrast, gritty, professional sports documentary style. Leave negative space in the center.
image_generation_prompts_nano_banana.PricingPremiumTexture: Macro close-up photography of technical sports fabric, like a high-end football jersey or modern running shoe mesh. Deep forest green color, tactical, minimalist, with subtle diagonal striations. Low lighting, premium.
image_generation_prompts_nano_banana.VIPCardAccent: A glowing golden crown insignia rendered in 3D wireframe style, floating against pitch black. Subtle metallic highlights.
image_generation_prompts_nano_banana.DashboardEmptyState: A cinematic close-up of a professional scout's clipboard and stopwatch resting on artificial turf. Shallow depth of field, moody lighting, forest green color grading.

hero_fallback.description: Aerial stadium night for hero background or VIP card texture. Apply a heavy cream overlay in CSS to preserve the text contrast.

dashboard_coach.description: Coach notebook image for dashboard empty state or welcome banner.

micro_interactions.buttons: Hover: rigid translation translate-y-[2px] translate-x-[2px] with a sharp, dense shadow shadow-[2px_2px_0_0_#0A1A12]. Active: translate-y-[4px] translate-x-[4px] with no shadow.
micro_interactions.cards: Hover: subtle 2px border color shift (e.g., border-[#0A1A12]/10 -> border-[#0A1A12]). Do NOT use soft blurring shadow. Use rigid translation if elevated.
micro_interactions.grid_items: Staggered fade-in on load using framer-motion. duration 0.4, delay 0.05 increments.
micro_interactions.thumbnails: Grayscale by default. group-hover:grayscale-0 group-hover:scale-105 duration-700 ease-out.

3. Dashboard Welcome & Banner: Refine the grid, add tactical notebook imagery to empty states.
4. Dashboard Reports & Players: Convert cards to sharp-edged Control Room grid items, implement grayscale hover effects on thumbnails.
